{{Quote|You are a credit to the Empire. But your task is not complete until you have regained control of the Star Destroyer.|Major Appleton, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:LSD" />}}
'''Appleton''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] and investigator who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was tasked with [[Retaking of the Blackguard|retaking]] the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Blackguard (Star Destroyer)|''Blackguard'']] from the traitorous Imperial [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] and self-proclaimed [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Andal Sait]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Major Appleton was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:LSD" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Major Appleton was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:Lost Star Destroyer|"Star Destroyer" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:LSD" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 8 Notes for Jan 15 2008|"Chapter 8" update]], on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67563&month=012008|text=Chapter 8: The Nova Orion Crisis}}</ref>
